*.so

local_settings.py
db.sqlite3
db.sqlite3-journal

target/

profile_default/
ipython_config.py

# Excludes local pdm configuration and build files.
pdm.lock
pdm.toml
.pdm-python
.pdm-build/

.pixi/*
!.pixi/config.toml

.envrc
.venv
env/
venv/
ENV/
env.bak/

# Conda environments
